items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Yes, I played at the Palladium with Heath and all bands there, Johnny Dankworth - just all the musicians I worked with there.

ctx.x: So one night I was playing and Johnny Garrett used to walk in back of me to make me smile. He'd do the Bronx cheer and I'd laugh. Barney happened to be there and he said, "What do you mean doing that and that's my star act." Johnny said, "You wanted her to smile, didn't you? Look at her now." And so he gave Johnny a raise.

Johnny Garrett came to the Cafe as a valet for us, where he pushed the piano on and off. He learned a great deal while he was there and he went out with Sarah and helped make her Vaughan/great. He's a terrific man. He just watched and he learned through watching and he became a great manager. Through him and Sarah Vaughan's husband and the pianist, they really brought her out in good style to the public.
